name: Hua Yu Lien Development Co., Ltd
summary: Hua Yu Lien Development Co., Ltd., with its headquarters located in Taipei City, Taiwan, is primarily involved in the construction, leasing, and selling of residential properties and buildings across the nation. Beyond its core real estate operations, the firm also maintains interests in the hospitality sector, specifically leisure and dining services. Established in 1967, the company transitioned from its previous identity, Fui Industrial Co., Ltd., to its current name in June 2013.
